scope: Curated diagnoses of retained development and runtime observations; setup failures are not counted as successful onboarding attempts.
private_evidence_root: /opt/emosa-baseline/ in the dedicated VM, copied to private .lab/peer-baseline/ storage

failures.diagnosis: The original companion hostapd did not include WPS and rejected WPS configuration fields.
failures.resolution: Separate pinned hostap build with CONFIG_WPS.

failures.diagnosis: Global regulatory configuration was denied inside the unprivileged network namespace.
failures.resolution: Use the VM regulatory state and permitted channel 6; retain iw reg get.

failures.diagnosis: The native HAL could not infer the band when radio settings were below the interface declaration.
failures.resolution: Put radio settings before interface= in the hostap file.

failures.diagnosis: BML was called before the colocated local agent created its platform socket.
failures.resolution: Start the helper and check BML readiness before configuring external-agent policy.

failures.diagnosis: Native M1/M2 and agent membership occurred, but stock hostapd rejected UPDATE and live SSIDs stayed at their initial values for the entire observation.
failures.resolution: Pinned fixed-layout file-update compatibility patch.

failures.diagnosis: The stock RELOAD command returned OK without reading the changed file or changing live SSIDs.
failures.resolution: Do not substitute RELOAD for the HAL file update.

failures.diagnosis: The first WPS supplicant link failed because libnl-route-3-dev was absent.
failures.resolution: Install and retain the complete build package inventory.

failures.diagnosis: The installed LXD CLI rejected --project on query during initial radio assignment.
failures.resolution: Read instance PID through lxc list JSON and finish the recorded pending setup.
failures.evidence: setup console and ownership.json; no measured attempt existed

failures.diagnosis: A wired client with no baseline systemd units caused journalctl to return No data available.
failures.resolution: Record that explicit empty-journal condition.
failures.evidence: runs/wireless-development-01/ and runs/wireless-development-02/; setup console failures

failures.diagnosis: The installed LXD config show command rejected --format json.
failures.resolution: Use lxc list JSON for device metadata.

failures.diagnosis: tcpdump refused the hwsim monitor because it was down.
failures.resolution: Bring up the owned hwsim0 monitor before capturing.

failures.diagnosis: WPS succeeded, but native wireless provisioning wrote VHT fields unsupported by the initial hostap build; live AP configuration did not update.
failures.resolution: Enable the VHT parser and set matching channel-width/center fields while keeping 802.11ac operation disabled.

failures.diagnosis: The validator mistook a neighbor record carrying the agent MAC for a duplicate agent record, so it rejected otherwise populated inventory.
failures.resolution: Match the exact Device and Radio object paths. Retain the failed validation result.

failures.diagnosis: The controller restarted without restored BSS policy, cleared its local AP SSIDs and failed wireless recovery within 120 seconds.
failures.resolution: Hold native transport while restoring policy; the next variant still exposed an additional dependency.

failures.diagnosis: The third controller-only restart with a policy barrier did not restore parent BSS inventory and repeatedly rejected the wireless child.
failures.resolution: Restart the controller and colocated local-agent helper together under the policy readiness barrier.

failures.diagnosis: Native controller and agent SIGTERM shutdown repeatedly produced SIGABRT/core-dump.
failures.resolution: Unresolved. Functional recovery passes are reported separately from clean shutdown.

failures.diagnosis: Credential updates replaced the primary BSS interface name with an empty bss= value. A subsequent actual AP-STA-DISCONNECTED event failed VAP lookup (Invalid vap_id -2), terminated the fronthaul event loop and caused repeated agent resets.
failures.resolution: Recorded libbwl source patch resolves primary interface= identity; the final version 2 selection passes in both backhaul modes with operational state, post-client stability and repeated fresh client probes.

failures.diagnosis: Version 1 accepted live BSS/inventory and client traffic without requiring native OPERATIONAL state or post-client stability. The later native reset loop invalidated any full-onboarding claim from those passes.
failures.resolution: Retain historical result statuses as preliminary, exclude them from the final qualified matrix, and repeat with acceptance version 2.

failures.diagnosis: The first overlay CMake configuration selected the upstream default dummy backend. Inspection caught it before deployment. The next NL80211 build lacked the hostapd configuration include path.
failures.resolution: Force and verify NL80211 cache selection, reject dummy compile commands and supply the upstream hostapd include dependency. Only the real NL80211 overlay is installed.

failures.diagnosis: After wired connectivity returned, a delayed parent topology report omitted the external agent. The controller deleted its device record and rebuilt it about a minute later. The first-ready predicate returned before this transition; the strict post-client observation failed. Both native agent roots remained OPERATIONAL.
failures.resolution: Retain the failed trial. Final outage recovery requires 30 continuous healthy seconds within the original 120-second limit, then client probes and the separate post-client stability check. No runtime behavior is changed for this measurement correction.
failures.evidence: runs/wired-stable-suite-01/backhaul-loss-02/; controller native log removes Device.2 at 08:45:03.457 and adds Device.3 at 08:46:00.624 UTC.
